description: Source code for Leaflet.markercluster plugin, defining the MarkerClusterGroup class that extends L.FeatureGroup to provide marker clustering functionality in Leaflet maps.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterGroup
classes.description: A class extending L.FeatureGroup that manages clustering of markers with options for animation, chunked loading, and coverage display.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer (marker or group) to the cluster group, clustering it if appropriate.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from the cluster group, updating clusters accordingly.

methods.name: addLayers
methods.description: Adds multiple layers in bulk, with optional chunked processing for performance.

methods.name: removeLayers
methods.description: Removes multiple layers in bulk, updating clusters accordingly.

methods.name: clearLayers
methods.description: Removes all layers from the cluster group.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the geographical bounds of all clusters and unclustered markers.

methods.name: eachLayer
methods.description: Iterates over all child layers, including clustered and unclustered markers.

methods.name: getLayers
methods.description: Returns an array of all child layers.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Returns a layer by its ID.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if a specific layer is in the cluster group.

methods.name: zoomToShowLayer
methods.description: Zooms to and optionally spiderfies a specific layer, then executes a callback.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the cluster group to a map, initializing clusters and event bindings.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the cluster group from a map, cleaning up event bindings and layers.

methods.name: getVisibleParent
methods.description: Returns the visible parent marker of a given marker.

methods.name: _removeLayer
methods.description: Internal method to remove a marker from clusters and update parent clusters.

methods.name: _mergeSplitClusters
methods.description: Handles merging or splitting clusters based on zoom level changes.

methods.name: _generateInitialClusters
methods.description: Initializes clustering grids and top-level cluster.

methods.name: _addLayer
methods.description: Internal method to add a layer to the appropriate cluster at the correct zoom level.

methods.name: _refreshClustersIcons
methods.description: Updates icons of all visible clusters that are marked as dirty.

methods.name: _processQueue
methods.description: Processes queued functions after zoom/cluster animations.

methods.name: _enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a function to be called after cluster animations.

methods.name: _checkBoundsMaxLat
methods.description: Expands bounds to Infinity if reaching maximum latitude limits.

methods.name: _animationZoomIn
methods.description: Handles animated zoom-in clustering transition.

methods.name: _animationZoomOut
methods.description: Handles animated zoom-out clustering transition.

methods.name: _animationAddLayer
methods.description: Handles animated addition of a layer to a cluster.
